description.narrative: (Morocco): .Despite Morocco's successful pro-market reforms in recent years, many Moroccans continue to express a profound sense of exclusion rooted in the belief that these gains are not spread evenly across different groups and regions. USAID aims to address this sense of exclusion through integrated governance and economic growth programming in one of Morocco's most marginalized regions: Beni Mellal-Khenifra (BMK). ISED-BMK is working closely with regional governments, the private sector, academia, and civil society to increase civic participation in local governance, support capabilities of sub-national governments in planning and budgeting, improve the business-enabling environment, and enhance employability and employment of target populations. ISED-BMK is continuing a model of co-creation to implement this program, ensuring all activities are tailored to local needs, and that stakeholder engagement helps shape a collaborative, iterative, and highly adaptive relationship among partners. ..This implementing mechanism will meet the $250,000 attribution to women's leadership..
